sources_used: UBS Group AG FY20-FY24 Annual Reports + Q1-Q3 2025 results (https://www.ubs.com/global/en/investor-relations)
_ordering_rationale: Banque post-CS integration (juin 2023) : CET1 (KPI maitre solvabilité), Wealth Management AuM, RoTE, Investment Bank, Cost/Income.

kpis.signal: Cible >14% post-CS integration, marge confortable + buyback resumé 2024
kpis.description_fr: Ratio CET1 (Common Equity Tier 1) UBS Group. Post-acquisition Credit Suisse (juin 2023), UBS reste sur-capitalisée. Cible >14%, buyback FY24-25.
kpis.description_en: UBS Group CET1 capital ratio. Post-Credit Suisse acquisition (June 2023), UBS over-capitalized. Target >14%, FY24-25 buyback resumed.

kpis.signal: #1 mondial Wealth Management hors US (post-CS), cible 5 T$ d'ici 2028
kpis.description_fr: Encours sous gestion Wealth Management UBS (Global Wealth Management). #1 mondial hors US après intégration Credit Suisse Wealth.
kpis.description_en: UBS Global Wealth Management invested assets. #1 globally ex-US after Credit Suisse Wealth integration.

kpis.signal: Restauration rentabilité post-CS, cible ~15% d'ici 2026 via synergies (cost-out >13 Mds $)
kpis.description_fr: Return on CET1 capital UBS (= bénéfice net / CET1 moyen). Cible 15% d'ici 2026 via synergies CS (>13 Mds $ run-rate cost-out).
kpis.description_en: UBS Return on CET1 capital (net income / avg CET1). 2026 target ~15% via CS synergies (>$13B cost-out run-rate).

kpis.signal: Rebond M&A + ECM/DCM, capital allocation discipline (<25% RWA groupe)
kpis.description_fr: CA Investment Bank UBS (Global Banking + Global Markets). Rebond M&A + ECM/DCM, capital discipline (<25% RWA groupe).
kpis.description_en: UBS Investment Bank revenue (Global Banking + Global Markets). M&A + ECM/DCM rebound, capital discipline (<25% group RWA).

kpis.signal: Amélioration progressive vs pic 92.4% FY23 (intégration CS). Cible <70% d'ici 2026.
kpis.description_fr: Ratio Coûts / Revenus UBS. Pic FY23 dû intégration CS, retour normalisé attendu <70% d'ici 2026 via synergies.
kpis.description_en: UBS Cost/Income ratio. FY23 peak due to CS integration, expected normalization <70% by 2026 via synergies.

kpis.signal: Boost intégration CS Asset Mgmt, focus alternatives + passifs (UBS ETF)
kpis.description_fr: Encours UBS Asset Management (institutionnel + retail). Boost intégration CS Asset Mgmt, expansion alternatives.
kpis.description_en: UBS Asset Management invested assets (institutional + retail). Boost from CS Asset Mgmt integration, alternatives expansion.

_notes: UBS FY = calendaire. Acquisition Credit Suisse finalisée juin 2023. Sources : Annual Reports FY20-FY24 + Q1-Q3 2025 results.
